test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses the indefinite article.

options.text: In an big city like Mumbai, we see lot of rubbish being thrown from households and factories.
In big city like Mumbai, we see a lot of rubbish being thrown from households and factories.
In a big city like Mumbai, we see a lot of rubbish being thrown from households and factories.
In a big city like Mumbai, we see an lot of rubbish being thrown from households and factories.

solution:
The correct answer is "**In a big city like Mumbai, we see a lot of rubbish being thrown from households and factories"****.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Here we will see the sentence formation:

__
 
• Indefinite article **‘A’ **is used at the start of a consonant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's learn more about indefinite articles:

__
 
• There are two articles in the English language:*** ‘A’ and ‘An.’***
 
• Indefinite article* **‘A’** *is used at the start of a*** consonant***, and** *‘An’*** is used at the beginning of every*** vowel. ‘An’*** is used when you use a word starting with** *vowels*, **which are** *a, e, i, o, u.***
 
 
• ***​Eg. __***__An __Owl Stays Awake in the Night.
 
• **Eg. ** __A __Girl was Walking Down the Street When She Saw a Man Following her.
